title: Questions 181-185 refer to the following announcement and e-mail.
passage_1:
Ashfield Learning Center – Saturday Maker Workshops

The confirmed timetable for this Saturday’s Maker Workshops appears below. We remind all volunteer leaders to post their session outlines and handouts to the member site by Thursday evening so that participants can print them beforehand.

As you know, any supplies needed for your workshop must be ordered in advance. Please check the Requested Supplies column carefully to make sure it lists everything you asked for. If you cannot run your session as planned, please inform the reception desk at least 72 hours before the event.

Workshop Schedule – Studio 214

TimeWorkshop TopicLeaderRequested Supplies
9:30 A.M.Beginner CircuitryNathan VossWire Trays, Cutters
11:00 A.M.Drone AssemblyCamille FournierMonitor, Stand
12:30 P.M.Ceramic SculptingHugo Lindqvist, Priya AnandWheels, Clay Bins
3:30 P.M.Rooftop CompostingRosa Delgado, Kenji MatsudaSoil Crates, Rakes
To:Alan Prescott <director@ashfieldcenter.org>
From:Priya Anand <p.anand@claystudio.com>
Date:January 9
Subject:Workshop

Dear Mr. Prescott,

I am writing about the workshop scheduled for this Saturday. I am looking forward to leading the session, but a couple of problems have arisen.

First, my partner has unfortunately injured his shoulder and will not be able to demonstrate the shaping techniques properly. Therefore, a coworker from our studio, Delia Nkemdirim, will be taking his place to assist me. She is a skilled instructor and is well familiar with the session outline for the workshop.

Second, would it be possible to swap our time slot with that of the workshop scheduled directly after ours? Ms. Nkemdirim has a prior commitment at a craft fair, so she will not be able to reach the center in time for our original start time.

Please let me know whether these adjustments can be accommodated.

Sincerely,
Priya Anand
